patches.before: • Package rollback: the package-level rollback is COS Glasses 6.10.653 with the same server 6.92.0: the Hub release for 6.10.654 names it, its complete versioned EHPK is in the Hub repository, and it is what Even Hub lists. Server 6.67.0 is retained separately for runtime rollback; with it, Meeting Ask on the phone, the lens and the Mac shows an update message and recording keeps working. The complete versioned 6.10.629 EHPK is also preserved in the Hub repository, and on Even App 2.2.9, 607 is the newest build that installs. Builds 580 and earlier cannot read the protected v2 Sessions queue or pending speaker edits. Resolve pending work before an older downgrade; do not clear app storage to downgrade. Choose Sonnet before downgrading: the older picker does not understand the Luna preference. Let Saved turns drain before going below 6.9.563. That older store build lacks Work, the prompt overlay, later reader fixes and the current footer controls.
